policy: Only the exact canonical identity is accepted. Retired names are historical evidence, never active aliases.

inventory.durableDestination: Shared identity rule, manifest validation and post-resolution generation validation
inventory.removalEvidence: Canonical rule exported to native adapters and RevCon; schema and generation regression tests reject retired inputs. Committed snapshots regenerated from staged sources.

inventory.priorBehavior: Profile directory and private-profile lookup accepted a retired identity.
inventory.durableDestination: Canonical profile directory and validated profile selection
inventory.removalEvidence: Canonical copy delivery passes; retired and differently cased fleet profiles are rejected without writes; profile listing filters them. Existing managed content digests verified against staged files.

inventory.removalEvidence: Duplicate alias exports and fallbacks removed; fleet-root and planning-command suites pass.

inventory.priorBehavior: Session-state loading accepted a retired environment namespace and home-directory fallback.
inventory.removalEvidence: Canonical root wins; retired environment input is ignored; regression is integrated into the maintained validator runner.

inventory.priorBehavior: Daemon and local fleet map used different fleet environment names.
inventory.removalEvidence: Alternate root fallback removed; fleet map uses the canonical root; daemon typecheck and Rust formatting pass after normal protocol build.

inventory.priorBehavior: Archive and handoff readers used a retired configuration prefix.

inventory.removalEvidence: Archive loader regression rejects the retired environment input; package builds pass.

inventory.priorBehavior: Maintained root and archive primitives accepted or documented retired namespaces.
inventory.owner: Private planning configuration and archive workflow
inventory.durableDestination: Canonical fleet root, archive, checkout and planning namespaces
inventory.removalEvidence: Root fallback removed; maintained callers renamed; root, session, rewrite and fleet-sync fixtures pass. Canonical archive-token secret confirmed present through read-only GitHub metadata.

inventory.priorBehavior: Merge-method guard identified the backflow actor by a retired app name.
inventory.owner: Shared backflow guard and organization workflow
inventory.removalEvidence: GitHub app and bot verified read-only; canonical actor accepted and retired actor rejected by tests.

inventory.location: Shared leak classifier and fleet check-no-private-leaks.sh consumers
inventory.priorBehavior: Private-path detection depended on a retired root spelling.
inventory.durableDestination: Detect canonical private paths while retaining historical-path detection
inventory.removalEvidence: Canonical and historical inputs remain detectable; historical detection does not configure or resolve an alias. Built classifier and regression suite pass.

historicalEvidence: Original transcripts, archives and historical scan fingerprints remain unchanged. Historical input fixtures are retained only for rejection, privacy detection or canonical-output repair tests.
organizationTransition: Repository transfers are checked individually. No GitHub repository URL is replaced merely because another repository has transferred.
